steps.name: All In payout is the API multiplier × amount
backend returned no multiplier for the slip

Expect "toHaveText" getByTestId('payout-all-in').or(locator('div.flex.justify-between').filter({ has: getByText('Perfect line-up') }).locator('p.font-museo.text-xl').filter({ visible: true })).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Insured payouts are the insured multipliers × amount
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'Insured', exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).first()

Expect "toHaveText" getByTestId('payout-insured-high').or(locator('div.flex.justify-between').filter({ has: getByText(/^(\d+)\/\1 correct$/) }).locator('p.font-museo.text-xl').filter({ visible: true })).filter({ visible: true }).first()

Expect "toHaveText" getByTestId('payout-insured-low').or(locator('div.flex.justify-between').filter({ has: getByText(/^\d+\/\d+ correct$/) }).locator('p.font-museo.text-xl').filter({ visible: true }).nth(1)).filter({ visible: true }).first()
Click getByRole('button', { name: 'All In', exact: true }).filter({ visible: true }).first()

Expect "toBeVisible" getByTestId('payout-all-in').or(locator('div.flex.justify-between').filter({ has: getByText('Perfect line-up') }).locator('p.font-museo.text-xl').filter({ visible: true })).filter({ visible: true }).first()
